title: NodeGX library entry metadata (library.json)
description: Per-entry metadata for a prefab or module under library/{prefabs,modules}/<slug>/library.json. See library/README.md.

label.description: Display name shown on the library card.

description.description: Short description shown on the library card.

type.description: Explicit entry kind. Replaces the legacy '/prefab' substring check on the project zip URL.

icon.description: Filename of the icon image within this entry's directory (e.g. 'icon.png'). Omit if there is no icon.

docsPath.description: Docs-site path shown as the 'Read docs' link, e.g. '/library/prefabs/date-picker/'.

version.description: Semver content version. Bumping this changes the built zip's filename, which is what makes the editor's forever-cache correct instead of a trap.

minEditorVersion.description: Lowest NodeGX editor version this entry is known to work with. Entries above the running editor's version render as incompatible instead of being offered for install.

runtimeVersion.description: noodl-runtime version this entry was authored/verified against. DESCRIPTIVE PROVENANCE, NOT A REQUIREMENT, and deliberately ungated: unlike minEditorVersion there is no comparand — the editor has no runtime version to check it against (measured 2026-08-18: no constant, no generated file, no dependency edge from noodl-editor to noodl-runtime). CN-016 item 3 considered a minRuntimeVersion floor and did not add one, because a schema field nothing can evaluate is worse than an absent one: library:check would accept it while every consumer ignored it in silence. It becomes worth adding the day the editor knows its runtime version.

provenance.description: Where seeded (LIB-001) content came from. Entries authored directly in this repo (LIB-002/003 and later) may omit this.
